card.name: Inside drug and brand names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a drug or brand name split into parts, such as the 'of' in levofloxacin, 'VIP' in YORVIPATH, 'MB' in SYMBRAVO and 'fib' in gemfibrozil. It also fires on a similar middle piece inside a surname.
